comment: Audited npm lifecycle scripts for the registry runtime lock. Anything not listed here (and not explicitly denied) fails the build. Denied scripts are never executed on user machines; `prepare` is ignored because npm does not run it for registry tarballs.

allowed.reason: 仅在安装目录内恢复 node-pty 预构建 spawn-helper 的可执行位；不联网、不写应用外路径。

denied.reason: 可能下载编译器或触发本地编译；dsh 的 shell 工具在 Woohaa 中被禁用，预构建二进制已足够。
安装后脚本会尝试修补/下载原生构建产物；运行期不执行。
上游仅打印赞助提示，无安装副作用；运行期不执行。
